name: es30-framebuffer-blit-msaa
title: Framebuffer blits and multisample resolve
summary: glBlitFramebuffer between separate READ and DRAW framebuffers checked against one CPU model of the blit rule: color with NEAREST and LINEAR, 2x and 3:1 scaling, mirroring by swapped coordinates, sub-rectangles, clipping on both sides, the scissor test, write masks ignored; depth and stencil copies proven by depth- and stencil-tested draws; glReadBuffer picking the source and every draw buffer receiving the copy; multisample renderbuffers sized from glGetInternalformativ and resolved by a blit, asserting only what ES 3.0 section 4.3.3 defines (filter ignored, nothing written outside an identical-bounds sub-rectangle, uniformly cleared depth/stencil resolving to their values, and in ES 3.1+ contexts an RGBA8UI resolve whose every pixel is one of its own samples read back with texelFetch(usampler2DMS)) while the implementation-dependent RGBA8 resolve is only observed; and the INVALID_OPERATION / INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION cases of ES 3.0 section 4.3.3.
spec: ES 3.0 §4.3.3 Copying Pixels (glBlitFramebuffer: rectangles and mirroring, NEAREST/LINEAR, clipping, scissor, masks ignored, format conversion, every error condition; multisample resolve: integer and stencil "a single sample's value is selected", depth "between the minimum and maximum depth values", normalized "implementation-dependent"); ES 3.2 §16.2.1 for the same rules in ES 3.1+ contexts
ES 3.0 §4.3.1 Selecting a Buffer for Reading, §4.3.2 Reading Pixels (SAMPLE_BUFFERS = 1 is INVALID_OPERATION)
ES 3.0 §4.4.1 Binding and Managing Framebuffer Objects (READ_FRAMEBUFFER / DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER)
ES 3.0 §4.4.2.1 Renderbuffer Objects (glRenderbufferStorageMultisample, RENDERBUFFER_SAMPLES), §4.4.2.2 Required Renderbuffer Formats
ES 3.0 §4.4.4.2 Whole Framebuffer Completeness (SAMPLE_BUFFERS and SAMPLES), §4.4.4.4 Effects of Framebuffer Completeness on Framebuffer Operations
ES 3.0 §6.1.15 Internal Format Queries (glGetInternalformativ: NUM_SAMPLE_COUNTS, SAMPLES); ES 3.1 §19.3 / ES 3.2 §20.3 for integer formats in newer contexts
ES 3.0 §4.1.2 Scissor Test, §4.1.4 Stencil Test, §4.1.5 Depth Buffer Test, §4.2.2 Fine Control of Buffer Updates, §4.2.3 Clearing the Buffers
ES 3.0 §2.1.6.2 Conversion from Floating-Point to Normalized Fixed-Point (equation 2.3), §2.5 GL Errors
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.8.2 Output Layout Qualifiers, §5.1 Operators (bitwise), §7.1 gl_VertexID, §7.2 gl_FragCoord
ES 3.0 §4.2.3.1 Clearing the Multisample Buffer (scissored clears set every sample of a pixel), Appendix A.1 Repeatability

ES 3.2 §8.8 Multisample Textures (glTexStorage2DMultisample), §11.1.3.3 Multisample Texel Fetches; GLSL ES 3.10 §8.9.2 texelFetch(gsampler2DMS), §4.7.4 (no default precision for usampler2DMS), §1.1 (one language version per program) - ES 3.1+ contexts only

api.glBlitFramebuffer: color 1:1, sub-rectangle, 2x and 3:1 NEAREST, 2x and 2:1 LINEAR, mirrored in x / y / both, both-swapped (no reversal), destination and source clipped, scissored, with all color writes masked: the whole destination equals a CPU model (NEAREST exact, LINEAR +-2); depth and stencil copied 1:1, 2x, mirrored, one at a time, with failing write masks and tests active: probed with depth- and stencil-tested draws; multisample resolve: LINEAR identical to NEAREST, identical-bounds sub-rectangle writes nothing outside the rectangle (RGBA8 and RGBA8UI) and its RGBA8UI pixels inside are each one of their own samples (RGBA8 inside only observed), uniformly cleared depth/stencil resolved to exactly their values (probed), RGBA8UI resolve (ES 3.1+) equal in every pixel to one of its own samples (texelFetch per sample); RGBA8 resolved values only observed; mask 0 copies nothing; INVALID_OPERATION for LINEAR with depth/stencil (nothing copied), DEPTH24_STENCIL8 -> DEPTH_COMPONENT16, resolve with scaling / translation / mirroring (nothing copied), multisample -> RGB565, multisample draw framebuffer, identical buffers, integer/fixed-point/signed/unsigned mismatches, LINEAR on integer data; INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION for an incomplete read or draw framebuffer; missing buffers are ignored silently
api.glBindFramebuffer: READ_FRAMEBUFFER and DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER bound to different objects: glReadPixels reads one and glClear writes the other, READ/DRAW/FRAMEBUFFER binding queries, FRAMEBUFFER sets both
api.glReadBuffer: COLOR_ATTACHMENT1 / 2 select the blit source (copy equals that chart); READ_BUFFER is per framebuffer object
api.glDrawBuffers: {C0, NONE, C2} receives the copy in C0 and C2 and leaves C1 untouched
api.glGenFramebuffers: chart, destination, depth/stencil, multisample, resolve, control, integer and empty framebuffers
api.glFramebufferTexture2D: RGBA8 / RGBA8UI / RGBA8I textures as color attachments; framebuffers complete, contents blitted and read back
api.glFramebufferRenderbuffer: multisample RGBA8 / DEPTH24_STENCIL8, RGB565, SRGB8_ALPHA8, DEPTH_COMPONENT16 renderbuffers attached; the blits and resolves read and write them
api.glCheckFramebufferStatus: every fixture framebuffer complete (including both multisample ones); the empty framebuffer is incomplete (INVALID_FRAMEBUFFER_OPERATION on blit)
api.glBindRenderbuffer: target for storage and parameter queries
api.glRenderbufferStorage: RGBA8, RGB565, SRGB8_ALPHA8, DEPTH24_STENCIL8, DEPTH_COMPONENT16 targets used by the blits; RENDERBUFFER_SAMPLES = 0
api.glRenderbufferStorageMultisample: allocated with every sample count glGetInternalformativ reports (RENDERBUFFER_SAMPLES between the request and the next larger count) and with the largest count of RGBA8, DEPTH24_STENCIL8, DEPTH_COMPONENT16, STENCIL_INDEX8 and SRGB8_ALPHA8 (exactly that many samples); integer formats: INVALID_OPERATION in a 3.0 context, working in 3.1+
api.glGetRenderbufferParameteriv: RENDERBUFFER_SAMPLES (equals the largest reported count, 0 for glRenderbufferStorage) and WIDTH
api.glGetInternalformativ: NUM_SAMPLE_COUNTS and SAMPLES for 15 renderbuffer formats (>= 1, strictly descending, positive, largest >= MAX_SAMPLES), bufSize 0 / 1 / larger, integer formats (0 in ES 3.0, >= 1 in 3.1+); negative bufSize -> INVALID_VALUE, RGB9_E5 -> INVALID_ENUM
api.glTexStorage2D: immutable RGBA8 / RGBA8UI / RGBA8I images used as framebuffer attachments
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of every compared image, RGBA_INTEGER/UNSIGNED_INT readback of the integer fixtures; INVALID_OPERATION from a multisample framebuffer
api.glClear: COLOR/DEPTH/STENCIL of the destinations and scenes; the separate-binding test shows it writes the DRAW framebuffer only
api.glClearColor: sentinel and scene colors, observed in the read-back images
api.glClearDepthf: depth 1 in the cleared targets and the region depths of the scissored multisample scene: probed with tested draws
api.glClearStencil: stencil 0 in the cleared targets and the region values of the scissored multisample scene: probed with tested draws
api.glClearBufferfv: per-attachment sentinel colors of the destination, read back
api.glClearBufferuiv: unsigned integer fixtures (whole target and a scissored block): the integer blit copies them exactly; the RGBA8UI multisample texture cleared to the background value, found in every uncovered sample by texelFetch
api.glEnable: SCISSOR_TEST, DEPTH_TEST and STENCIL_TEST: scissor limits a blit; the tests are the probes
api.glDisable: the tests restored; the blit model without the scissor is shown to differ
api.glScissor: the box (20,30)-(60,55) limits the 2x blit to exactly that box; scissored clears write the multisample depth/stencil scene (resolved and probed region by region)
api.glColorMask: all four channels masked during a blit: the blit still writes every pixel
api.glDepthMask: FALSE during a blit (still copies); FALSE in every probe pass (probes leave depth unchanged)
api.glDepthFunc: ALWAYS while writing the scene, LESS in the probes, NEVER during a blit that must still copy
api.glStencilFunc: ALWAYS/REPLACE while writing the scene, EQUAL k in the probes, NEVER during a blit that must still copy
api.glStencilOp: REPLACE writes the scene's stencil values; KEEP in every probe
api.glViewport: target-sized viewports for the charts, scenes, triangle and probes
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_rect, u_z, u_color, u_tri, u_size located; effects visible in the images
api.glUniform1f: u_z (depth of the scene rectangles) and u_size
api.glUniform4f: u_rect and u_color: rectangle placement and color verified in the images
api.glUniform2fv: u_tri[3]: the triangle's corners; classified pixels match its geometry
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP quads and the TRIANGLES triangle from gl_VertexID
api.glGetIntegerv: READ/DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING, FRAMEBUFFER_BINDING, READ_BUFFER, SAMPLES, SAMPLE_BUFFERS, MAX_SAMPLES
api.glTexStorage2DMultisample: ES 3.1+ contexts: RGBA8UI 2D multisample texture with the largest reported count; framebuffer complete with SAMPLE_BUFFERS 1 and SAMPLES >= the request; every sample read back with texelFetch holds the cleared or the drawn value; resolved by a blit
api.glUniform4ui: u_value of the integer triangle: found exactly in the covered samples of the RGBA8UI multisample texture
api.glUniform1i: u_sample selects the sample texelFetch reads (each pass returns a different sample image) and u_ms the texture unit

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture viewed (llvmpipe and zink captures are identical to each other and differ from it by at most 1/255 per channel, except the multisample edge pixels, 8 vs 4 samples, up to 55/255). Top-left: the 64x64 chart stretched 2x with NEAREST, visible 2x2 blocks, red growing to the right, green upward, 8x8 blue/dark checkerboard. Top-right: the same chart with LINEAR, smooth transitions between texel centers, checkerboard edges soft. Bottom-left: the copied depth/stencil scene shown through tested draws: red lower-left block (depth 0.25 failed every test), cyan upper-right (stencil 2), black lower-right (stencil 3), gray upper-left strip (unwritten: depth 1.0, stencil 0). Bottom-right: an orange triangle on a dark blue background with smooth, anti-aliased edges and no stair steps. No seams or stray pixels; each panel fills its quarter exactly.
